raw.description:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy helps our customers, partners and colleagues become self-sufficient with the Quantexa Platform. We do that through online learning, instructor-led sessions and bespoke digital resources that let every user harness the power of our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an Instructional Designer to join our Design & Publish Team within Education Services. You'll turn complex technical topics – data, analytics, software and FinTech – into clear, engaging and accessible learning experiences, taking projects from first conversation with a subject matter expert through to a polished, published solution.

This is a role for an independent problem solver. You'll own your design projects end to end, decide how best to approach each one, and organize your own time across several priorities at once, spotting risks early and keeping stakeholders informed without needing to be chased. You'll work alongside Product, R&D and Delivery experts, and have the room to bring your own ideas on tools, approaches and how we use AI to design better learning.

If you love making hard things easy to learn, and do your best work with autonomy and trust, we'd like to hear from you.

This is a hybrid role, with the expectation of attending the company office in central London twice a week.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and update technical learning solutions for customers, partners and employees, covering storyboards, articles, documentation, presentations, and eLearning.

  • Apply best practice in learning design methodologies, accessibility, and user experience, so every learner has a great experience.

  • Build assessments and use learner feedback and data to shape your design decisions.

  • Use AI-assisted tools to speed up research, authoring and quality checks, with human review to keep content accurate and aligned to learning objectives.

  • Work with subject matter experts, and with Product, Delivery and R&D teams, to understand the Platform and turn that knowledge into effective training.

  • Take ownership of your programs, keeping them current and aligned as the Platform evolves.

  • Research technical documentation, demos, recordings, and learner feedback to make sure our content is accurate and high quality.

  • Plan and track your own content projects, flagging risks and blockers early and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

  • Use tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint and Asana to manage tasks, document your work and collaborate across teams.

  • Identify, propose and lead the introduction of new tools, processes or AI approaches that improve our learning design and the learner experience.

  • Support teammates through feedback and knowledge sharing, and take the lead on projects where it's useful.

What you'll bring.

Essential

  • Experience designing technical or complex training content – for example in FinTech, analytics, data science, data engineering or software development.

  • Solid knowledge of designing, delivering, and evaluating training programs grounded in adult learning principles and instructional design theories.

  • Good understanding of at least one programming language (Java, Scala, Python or any other OOP)

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and concisely.

  • Confident use of Microsoft Office 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint)

  • Experience, or real curiosity, in using GenAI for content creation, automation and productivity.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing needs.

  • A collaborative, proactive and solution-focused approach, and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Experience with an LMS and using learner data or feedback to improve content.

  • Experience coordinating projects that involve several stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or sharing knowledge with colleagues, or an interest in doing so.

  • Familiarity with Confluence, Jira or Asana.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

 

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description: About Sona Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here ( https://www.sona.ai/careers ). About the Role We're hiring a Founding Account Executive to win Sona's first customers in Italy and open the market for us. This is a senior, seller-first role, and you'll run every conversation with prospects in Italian, from the first call to the close. Our expansion into Europe is starting now and ramps up through 2027 across key markets. Italy is one of them, and you'll own the go-to-market launch there. Colleagues across Sona will be running the product, operations and other launch activities, so your focus is winning customers, building partnerships and creating the collateral to sell. With no sales team in market yet, you'll work with less support than a typical AE, and the team around you will grow as the market does. Day to day, you'll decide which Retail and Hospitality accounts to go after, from mid-market through to enterprise, and run consultative sales conversations yourself. You'll also build what a new market needs, including partnerships and Italian-language collateral. The platform is already localised for Italy, and you'll have product and solutions support. It's early, and the ground will shift as we learn what works. If you want a structured environment with lots of support around you, this won't be the right fit. If you want to shape how Sona sells in Italy from the start, it could be exactly that. The role is office-based in London, with travel to Italy as needed. Responsibilities Lead the go-to-market launch in Italy and win Sona's first customers, taking each deal from first conversation to close. Build your own pipeline across Retail and Hospitality, from mid-market to enterprise. Run strategic, consultative sales conversations in Italian. Build and run partnerships that open doors in the Italian market. Create the collateral Sona needs to sell in Italy. Work with Sona's Strategy and Expansion Lead on where to focus and how to approach the market. Feed what you learn from the market back to our Commercial and Product teams. Travel to Italy as the role requires. Requirements You're a native Italian speaker, comfortable selling and negotiating in Italian, with fluent English for working with colleagues in London. You have a senior Account Executive track record of winning new business, ideally across mid-market and enterprise deals. You have a founder mentality. You take ownership, make decisions with limited information, and are happy building without a playbook. You're strategic and consultative in how you sell, and you work well independently with less support than most AEs get. You're comfortable creating partnerships and collateral from scratch. You're based in London, or able to be, and happy to travel to Italy as the role needs. Strongly preferred: Spanish, French or German as an additional language. It doesn't replace Italian. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. description: View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/fao *** THE KEY BITS Location : We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK. Flexibility : We have office hubs in London and Boston, as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub. Salary : We benchmarked £45,000 + equity at IC2 in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. Let us know in your application if you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for. Interviews : 2 stages totalling around 2.5 hours over 2 weeks, plus some prep for a task. Start date : As soon as you can start. Reporting to : Ryan, Interim Finance Director (while Eimear, Finance Director, is on leave) More info : The FAQ below, juro.com/careers , our handbook or ask ----- style="min-height:1.5em"> HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it . Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity. Juro bills customers and pays suppliers across UK and US entities, and the volume keeps growing. We’re looking for someone who carries the day-to-day weight of finance operations together with the team. Roughly 60% of your week goes on AP/AR, and the rest is month-end and reporting support: reconciliations, revenue review, and pulling together what’s needed for statutory accounts, audit requests and VAT returns. You won’t be doing this alone: you’ll work closely with Charlotte, our Financial Controller, who owns the close, and Ryan, our Interim Finance Director (stepping in for Eimear), who leads the Finance function. Your mission is to: Own invoicing, payables and collections end-to-end so Juro gets paid efficiently, accurately and with strong control of cash, and support month-end so leadership can trust the numbers. Success looks like: Invoices done right first time: Contracts are turned into accurate invoices with minimal rework or back-and-forth with Sales and Customer Success. Money moving smoothly: Customers pay on time and suppliers are paid accurately across our UK and US entities. You keep an up-to-date view of what’s owed in and out, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) comes down over time. Reliable month-end support: Your reconciliations are accurate and on time, you flag escalations early, and you contribute to month-end, revenue review and statutory reporting. Solid, scalable ops: Processes are well controlled (from supplier onboarding and bank detail checks to payment run approvals), audit-ready, and increasingly automated inside Rillet (our ERP) and Ramp (our spend management system). You improve the process notes rather than just following them. We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub .   • Salary: We benchmarked £45,000 + equity at IC2 in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. Let us know in your application if you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for.

  • Interviews: 2 stages totalling around 2.5 hours over 2 weeks, plus some prep for a task.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

    HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

    Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

    Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

    Juro bills customers and pays suppliers across UK and US entities, and the volume keeps growing. We’re looking for someone who carries the day-to-day weight of finance operations together with the team.

    Roughly 60% of your week goes on AP/AR, and the rest is month-end and reporting support: reconciliations, revenue review, and pulling together what’s needed for statutory accounts, audit requests and VAT returns.

    You won’t be doing this alone: you’ll work closely with Charlotte, our Financial Controller, who owns the close, and Ryan, our Interim Finance Director (stepping in for Eimear), who leads the Finance function.

    Your mission is to:

    Own invoicing, payables and collections end-to-end so Juro gets paid efficiently, accurately and with strong control of cash, and support month-end so leadership can trust the numbers.

    Success looks like:

    1. Invoices done right first time: Contracts are turned into accurate invoices with minimal rework or back-and-forth with Sales and Customer Success.

    2. Money moving smoothly: Customers pay on time and suppliers are paid accurately across our UK and US entities. You keep an up-to-date view of what’s owed in and out, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) comes down over time.

    3. Reliable month-end support: Your reconciliations are accurate and on time, you flag escalations early, and you contribute to month-end, revenue review and statutory reporting.

    4. Solid, scalable ops: Processes are well controlled (from supplier onboarding and bank detail checks to payment run approvals), audit-ready, and increasingly automated inside Rillet (our ERP) and Ramp (our spend management system). You improve the process notes rather than just following them.

    We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

    WHO WE LOOK FOR

    Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

    To succeed here:

    Every Juror finds their balance across our four principles. We hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

    Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

    On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

    • You’ve done both AR and AP: raising invoices, handling billing queries, chasing payments or paying suppliers.

    • You’ve been the #1 point of contact for customers or suppliers on billing and payments. You can be firm about an overdue balance without damaging the relationship, and you keep Sales, CS and budget holders in the loop.

    • You’ve helped with a month-end, e.g. by doing bank or ledger reconciliations.

    • You’ve used finance systems day to day (NetSuite, Rillet, Xero, Ramp or similar) and pick up new tools quickly.

    • You read contracts carefully enough to know what should be invoiced, when, and what’s unclear, and you work with Sales and CS to get it right.

    • You notice repetitive manual work and want to fix it, whether that’s with a better spreadsheet, an automation or AI.

    Bonus points if:

    • You’ve worked with SaaS contracts or subscription billing.

    • You’ve helped with VAT returns, US sales tax, revenue reporting or audit requests.

    • You’ve worked in a multi-entity (UK/US) business with multi-currency invoicing.

    This job likely isn’t for you if:

    • You’re mainly looking for formal accounting training or a pathway to becoming ACA-qualified.

    • You want to own the month-end close or focus on technical accounting, rather than a hands-on mix of finance operations and reporting support.

    • You prefer clearly defined, static processes and don’t enjoy owning messy, real-world problems and making them better (especially with AI).

    OUR MISSION

    Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

    The load on legal teams is increasing as business teams move faster with the help of AI. The only way out is to deploy AI within the legal team so that (a) routine contract work can be executed autonomously and (b) lawyers’ time is reserved for problem solving.

    It’s like having an extra team member that is always on and takes on heavy lifting. Just like an in-house lawyer, Juro:

    • is present for, and trusted by, business teams

    • owns contracts from first draft to signature and beyond

    • builds judgement from every contract it works on

    …all within guardrails controlled by the legal team.

raw.title: Software Engineer (Application Platform/Tech Lead)
raw.description:
About Us

At TrustFlight, we are proud to be a global leader in mission-critical software systems and technical services, trusted by aerospace and aviation industries worldwide. Our innovative solutions power the safety and efficiency of aviation operations, ensuring the safety of hundreds of thousands of passengers and crew every month.

Why Join TrustFlight

✈️ Our Mission: To revolutionize aviation by delivering digital workflow solutions that enhance safety, streamline operations, and inspire confidence across the industry.

🚀 Impact: Over 200,000 users rely on our systems every day for operational safety, compliance management, and mission-critical decision-making.

🚩 Core Values: Guided by integrity, responsibility, innovation, and excellence, we are committed to empowering our partners to operate with confidence.

Join us in shaping the future of aviation and making an impact through technology.

Your Role

As a Software Engineer – Application Platform, you’ll help build secure, scalable platform foundations, especially around identity, authentication, and core system design. Beyond your individual technical contributions, you’ll be expected to act as a strong engineering leader within the organization by helping shape technical direction, raising engineering standards, and influencing how teams approach complex platform challenges.

This is an opportunity to have an impact beyond the code you write. You’ll bring technical leadership to architectural discussions, help others navigate difficult engineering decisions, and lead by example through strong ownership, sound judgment, and a commitment to quality. You’ll build trust across teams by sharing knowledge, challenging assumptions constructively, and helping drive initiatives forward.

You bring strong fundamentals in authentication and security, with a clear understanding of sign-in flows, protocol choices, and how identity connects across the broader system. A disciplined testing mindset and solid cloud and deployment knowledge ensure your work is reliable, verifiable, and production-ready.

Success in this role comes from taking ownership, communicating early, sharing context, and documenting decisions clearly. You’ll help teams stay aligned, reduce friction across the platform, and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence across TrustFlight.

What you’ll be doing

Development & Code Quality:

  • Design and implement features and fixes using modular, low-disruption approaches that preserve system integrity and long-term maintainability

  • Reason about complex, real-world data models, including multi-tenant systems, maintaining a clear mental model of how data is structured, accessed, and evolved

  • Play an active role in architectural discussions, helping guide technical decisions based on system constraints, scalability, security, and future growth

  • Debug and resolve complex platform issues by working directly with raw data, services, and infrastructure layers

  • Uphold and help raise engineering standards through clean, maintainable code, thoughtful technical trade-offs, and strong engineering practices

  • Take ownership of complex technical challenges and help drive them from ambiguity through to implementation and delivery

  • Take ambiguous, high-stakes technical problems from first principles through to delivery

Testing & Quality Assurance:

  • Maintain a strong testing discipline, ensuring all changes are well-covered by appropriate unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

  • Advocate for and implement quality-first engineering practices, including test automation and early validation of platform changes

  • Lead by example in establishing a high bar for quality, reliability, and maintainability

  • Ensure reliability and confidence in releases by validating behavior across services, environments, and tenant boundaries

DevOps & Infrastructure:

  • Work confidently with cloud-based infrastructure and deployment practices, contributing to reliable, scalable platform operations

  • Collaborate on or support CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows to enable safe, repeatable releases

  • Apply strong foundational knowledge of authentication and security, understanding sign-in flows, protocol choices, and how identity integrates with the broader system

  • Help guide platform-level decisions around stability, observability, security, and operational excellence as systems evolve

  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, tooling, and platform capabilities across the organization

Leadership, Collaboration & Communication:

  • Be a trusted technical voice within the organization, providing leadership through expertise, ownership, sound judgment, and collaboration

  • Help shape technical direction and engineering practices, influencing decisions beyond your immediate area of responsibility

  • Lead by example, demonstrating strong engineering habits and helping create a culture of accountability, quality, and continuous improvement

  • Support and mentor other engineers through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving

  • Collaborate effectively across the organization, including engineering, DevOps, product, and customer-facing teams when platform work intersects with delivery or product needs

  • Bring clarity to complex technical discussions, helping teams evaluate trade-offs, reach decisions, and move initiatives forward

  • Communicate frequently and openly with peers, sharing context, decisions, risks, and trade-offs to maintain alignment

  • Produce clear, thorough documentation for all work, proactively sharing outcomes with the platform team and impacted teams during cross-team initiatives

  • Stay engaged with platform evolution and industry best practices, continuously improving how the organization builds and operates software

  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, tooling, and platform capabilities


What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of software development experience with core platform technologies. Hands-on experience building, shipping, and maintaining production systems using Node.js, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with exposure to real-world trade-offs around scalability, reliability, and maintainability, and a solid understanding of how these technologies work together in scalable, maintainable applications.

  • Distributed systems and cloud architecture experience. Experience designing or contributing to cloud-based systems, with attention to scalability, fault tolerance, security, and operational concerns.

  • Authentication and identity fundamentals. Familiarity with modern authentication and identity concepts (e.g., OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SSO), including secure sign-in flows and how identity integrates with broader system architecture.

  • Microservices and API design experience. Experience building and maintaining service-oriented systems and well-structured APIs, with an understanding of versioning, reliability, and how services interact across distributed environments.

  • Strong software testing discipline (Unit, Integration, and End-to-End testing). A quality-first mindset with hands-on experience writing and maintaining meaningful tests, understanding where different testing strategies add value, and ensuring confidence in platform changes before release.

  • Relational database design and operation. Experience working with relational databases, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, data integrity, and reasoning about complex data models such as multi-tenant systems.

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting. A methodical, detail-oriented approach to diagnosing issues across application code, infrastructure, and data layers, with a willingness to dig deep to identify root causes.

  • Clear documentation and communication. Ability to document technical decisions, implementations, and operational processes, and to communicate effectively with both engineering peers and cross-functional teams.

  • A growth mindset. A willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve technical and product skills in a fast-evolving platform environment.

  • Practical familiarity with modern AI tooling. A practical understanding of modern AI capabilities and tooling, including strengths, limitations, and appropriate use cases, with an emphasis on applying AI responsibly to enhance systems, workflows, or developer productivity.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 

What makes you stand out

  • Technical excellence and awareness of platform engineering best practices

  • Enjoys mentoring, sharing knowledge, and supporting the growth of other engineers

  • Passion for aviation and experience thriving in fast-paced, dynamic environments

Location

This role is based in our Vancouver office. This is an on-site role with room for flexibility, because we know life doesn't always fit a 9-to-5 mould.

 

Why Join Us

  • Build and Create: Be part of an environment where you'll have the freedom to innovate, build, and create solutions that define the future of digital aviation.

  • Growth Opportunity: Join us at an inflection point as we scale our revenue growth using cutting-edge AI tools and SaaS best practices.

  • Invest in your future: Take advantage of our company contribution to pension/RRSP matching program to grow your savings while you work.

  • Competitive salary range: We place huge importance on the contribution and experience you bring to the team. The base pay offered is based on location and may vary depending on skills, job-related knowledge, experience, and internal equity.

We are looking for a senior crisis leader to direct that response across the UK, Europe and Africa. This is a role for someone who has stood in the room when it mattered, who leads with calm authority, and who believes that how an organisation treats the bereaved and the injured says everything about its character.

About Kenyon

Kenyon provides emergency planning, family assistance, humanitarian support and recovery services to clients around the world, drawing on a network of more than 2,500 trained responders who can be mobilised at short notice into any jurisdiction. Our clients rely on us to keep their promises to the people affected by an incident, and we hold ourselves to that standard every day, not only on the day of an activation.

Kenyon is part of the TrustFlight Group, an aviation safety and compliance technology business. That gives Kenyon something unusual in this sector: a world class technology team working alongside it, and a genuine commitment to using AI to make crisis response faster, better informed and more humane. Our values are simple and we mean them: integrity, and a customer first attitude in everything we do.

The role

Kenyon operates a two hub leadership model. You will lead the Bracknell hub, with regional accountability for operational delivery, readiness, contracted offices and relationships across the UK, Europe and Africa. Your peer, the Regional Director of Operations in Vancouver, leads the Americas and Asia Pacific. Together you share accountability for the readiness and quality of Kenyon’s response worldwide.

Senior Incident Director for activations

Senior on call duty is shared between the two Directors on a fixed twelve hour rota, with a structured handover at each change of duty, so that cover is continuous around the clock and neither Director works through their own night. Your window runs from approximately 06:00 to 18:00 UK time.

When an incident arises during your window, wherever in the world it occurs, you take up the role of Senior Incident Director. You will have the authority to set the deployment posture, commit responders and stand the organisation up or down without further approval. Where a client requires it, you will deploy as their strategic point of contact, leading the response on their behalf at the most demanding moments an organisation can face, including mass casualty, government led and politically sensitive events.

Major activations are infrequent, and Kenyon holds its capability through a surge based model rather than a large permanent workforce. Your judgement of regional readiness, kept current every week of the year, is what makes that model work.

What you will lead

·       Regional readiness and response. Maintain and continuously measure activation readiness across the UK, Europe and Africa, and develop the procedures, protocols and contingency plans that underpin it.

·       Your team and offices. Line manage the Regional Operations Manager in Bracknell, run the Bracknell hub and its regional operations as one regional function, and hold contracted offices to defined standards through quarterly reviews and an annual assessment.

·       Protecting those we serve. Make sure the information of casualties, families and clients is protected with the same care during and after an activation as on any other day.

·       The responder network. Work with the Responder Manager to keep the network vetted, trained and available across the region, including building language capable responders across Europe and Africa. Own the global standards for responder vetting, training currency, deployment conduct and post incident review, ensuring they are consistently applied across both hubs.

·       AI and digital quality assurance. Work with the Vancouver Director and TrustFlight Group technology team to define and evaluate AI enabled quality and operational reporting tools, including an AI internal auditor supporting ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 22300 evidence gathering, gap identification and audit trail maintenance. Ensure these tools meet group information security, data governance and ethical standards.

·       Global operational standards. Work with the Vancouver Director to compare regional procedures, share lessons learned and adopt improvements across both hubs, ensuring consistent service quality while recognising regional operational requirements.

·       Relationships that matter. Build trusted working relationships with government agencies, emergency services, aviation authorities and clients across the region, and provide the operational insight that informs board level reporting.

Why join us

·       Work that matters. Few roles offer the chance to lead a service whose sole purpose is to bring order, care and dignity to people at the worst moment of their lives.

·       Real authority. A senior seat on the Kenyon leadership team, reporting to the Managing Director, with decision making authority during activations.

·       A sustainable model. A shared rota designed so that no Director carries standing 24/7 availability, because sound judgement depends on rest.

·       Room to build. The opportunity to shape Kenyon’s growth across the UK, Europe and Africa, while leading the development of global quality, certification and responder standards and helping shape how AI strengthens operational assurance across Kenyon.

In your cover letter, tell us about an incident you have led and what it taught you about caring for the people affected. Applications will be treated in strict confidence.

title: Customer Value Architect III
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mixpanel</strong></p> <p>Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at <a href="https://mixpanel.com/home/">mixpanel.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Not a technical role, despite 'architect' in the title, this is relationship and strategy work, not engineering. Customer success, account management, or consulting backgrounds are a better fit than technical ones.</em></strong></p> <p>The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who thrives on connecting customers' Mixpanel investment to real business outcomes. You'll be the consultative owner of adoption, value, and AI maturity across a named portfolio of high-value accounts, engaged from onboarding through the full contract lifecycle. You are accountable for the outcome, not the commercial relationship owning the value case and the adoption plan behind it. You will build the executive relationships and strategic plans that make Mixpanel indispensable to how your customers build products.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Connect mixpanel to customer value</strong> <ul> <li>Own our value workstream with customers - understanding the business challenges that led them to buy Mixpanel, how they measure the ROI of their investment, and ensuring that they achieve that ROI by working across the customers’ teams and collaborating internally with other Mixpanel teams.</li> <li>Build and own relationships across business and technical stakeholders, including executive sponsors, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to customers' highest-priority goals.</li> <li>Develop and execute success plans that map customer business objectives to adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Perform ongoing discovery of the customer’s business priorities, internal toolset, and ongoing business pain – synthesize this information into actions that feed your success plans and share information with internal partners as needed.</li> <li>Operate in lockstep with the AE and renewal team, with clear lanes: you partner with the AE on expansion and growth motions and with the renewal team on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that underpins both. You own the value case; they own the commercial outcome.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Own value delivery and product relationship&nbsp;</strong> <ul> <li>Lead customer enablement sessions—covering topics like dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling—to grow Mixpanel usage depth and breadth across the customer organization.</li> <li>Proactively monitor product usage and health signals; lead regular business reviews to surface insights, deepen adoption, and surface risk early.</li> <li>Drive customer adoption - both identifying new pockets for Mixpanel usage within an organization and strategies for re-engagement where adoption is low.</li> <li>Identify underutilized features and contracted capabilities, translating them into concrete recommendations that expand customer value.</li> <li>Triage customer product requests and issues - solving their use case questions, basic troubleshooting and escalating as appropriate</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Own the AI Conversation</strong> <ul> <li>Assess a customer's AI maturity and advise on their agent and context strategy, this is now a first-class part of the job, not a bonus skill.</li> <li>Fluently use Mixpanel's own AI surface (Mixpanel AI, Mixpanel Agent, Headless, and MCP) to help customers building AI-native workflows on their product data.</li> <li>Use AI as a personal operating habit: a rehearsal partner for executive conversations, a discovery-prep engine and stakeholder sentiment analysis.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Be the voice of the customer to cross-functional partners</strong> <ul> <li>Coordinate across GTM, Product, and Engineering to manage escalations, advocate for customer needs, and bring the right resources to bear.</li> <li>Contribute to team playbooks and best practices that scale impact across the broader CS organization.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>We're Looking For Someone Who Has</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in Customer Success, management consulting, or a related field supporting complex B2B SaaS accounts.</li> <li>A track record of managing relationships at every level across different functions (from business executives to technical ICs) and influencing decisions at the C-suite level.</li> <li>The ability to translate technical concepts—data models, analytics instrumentation, product metrics—into business terms that resonate with non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to drive platform adoption and connect product usage to customer business outcomes.</li> <li>Experience building and executing strategic value and adoption plans – tying day-to-day activities to strategic outcomes and being able to communicate wins in terms of ROI.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with agentic or AI-native tooling. MCP-based workflows, LLM copilots, or similar (beyond casual ChatGPT use.)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.</li> <li>Experience in a technical advisory or solutions capacity (e.g., implementation, professional services).</li> <li>Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care</li> <li>Mental Wellness Benefit</li> <li>Generous Vacation Policy &amp; Additional Company Holidays</li> <li>Enhanced Parental Leave</li> <li>Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break</li> </ul> <p><em>*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*</em></p> <p><strong>Culture Values</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Make Bold Bets:</strong> We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.</li> <li><strong>Innovate with Insight:</strong> We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive&nbsp;powerful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>One Team:</strong> We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.</li> <li><strong>Candor with Connection:</strong> We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.</li> <li><strong>Champion the Customer:</strong> We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.</li> <li><strong>Powerful Simplicity:</strong> We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why choose Mixpanel?</strong></p> <p>We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: GTM Engineer
description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY . The Role We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion. raw.title: GTM Engineer
raw.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it.

You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer, using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.

You'll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build a better outbound engine: improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, sequencing and measurement so the team consistently reaches the right companies at the right time

  • Make the GTM team more productive: automate repetitive work across account research, meeting preparation, follow-ups, CRM hygiene and handoffs so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

  • Run the revenue operating infrastructure: own the systems behind pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation, renewals and expansion

  • Set the rules of engagement: own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person

  • Improve how revenue work moves through Kernel: build reliable routing, attribution, account assignment and cross-functional handoffs, resolve edge cases and make performance visible

  • Be Kernel's own internal customer: deploy Kernel on our CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and workflows, and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience: you have worked in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM Engineering at a high-growth Series B-E SaaS company and owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behavior

  • Strong GTM building ability: you have built useful systems with Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools, and you know how to move from a rough idea to a reliable workflow that people adopt

  • Commercial judgment: you understand how accounts become meetings, meetings become pipeline, pipeline is qualified and forecast, and won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention

  • Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented information into trustworthy workflows, measure what is working and create feedback loops that improve performance over time

  • Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC

  • Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning

  • Familiarity with Gong, sales engagement platforms and modern enrichment or intent tooling

  • Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself

  • Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress

  • See GTM Engineering primarily as CRM administration or ticket fulfillment rather than a revenue-generating function

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function

  • Prefer a predictable, low-intensity environment

  • Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup. We are in the office together 4-5 days a week and the pace is high

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £70,000-£90,000 + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 monthly office dinner allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to build the systems that power an AI-native revenue engine

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

❤️ Team

Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations

Amin Shafi, BizOps Associate

Dave Bentham, Head of Sales

🎫 Visas & Relocation

Not offered for this role.

Interview Process

  • Stage 1: Screening: Intro call

  • Stage 2: Technical: In-person case interview

  • Stage 3: Coffee chat: In-person discussion with members of our GTM team

  • Final stage: Values: Interview with founders for culture and values alignment

If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer.

Compensation: £70K – £90K • Offers Equity

title: Junior Compute Architect
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. About the Hardware organisation at Fractile Processor Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from compute engine definition and ISA design through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon. About the team and role As an Early Career Processor Architect, you’ll join our architecture team to learn how to define the compute engines, ISA definitions and programming models that sit at the heart of our silicon. Working closely with senior architects and our logical design, physical design, and verification teams, you’ll get real exposure to performance modelling, specification writing, bottleneck analysis, and pre- and post-silicon validation — with experienced architects mentoring you as you build toward owning more of this yourself. About you We’re looking for someone with a strong foundational understanding of computer or processor architecture — built through coursework, personal projects, internships, placements, or research — who’s genuinely curious about performance and power trade-offs and eager to learn how to navigate them. You don’t need prior industry experience as a Processor Architect; what matters is real hands-on exposure to processor or accelerator design, through a final-year project, FPGA build, RISC-V implementation, internship, or research, plus a comfort working across disciplines and a track record of thriving in ambiguity and fast iteration. Key Requirements A degree (BEng, MEng, MSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. A solid foundational understanding of computer/processor architecture, including matrix- and vector-centric floating-point arithmetic and memory hierarchies, gained through study, projects, internships, or research. Some exposure to RTL design concepts and how physical design constraints feed back into architectural choices — academic or internship-level experience is fine. Any hands-on exposure to architectural performance modelling tools (gem5, SystemC, or custom cycle-accurate simulators), compiler/toolchain interactions, or AI acceleration/vector-matrix compute, through study or projects, is highly valued. A clear communicator, comfortable working across architecture, modelling, implementation, verification, and software teams, who thrives in ambiguity and fast iteration. About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Hardware organisation at Fractile
System Architecture sits within the Hardware organisation at Fractile, responsible for designing the chips and systems that power our groundbreaking AI inference accelerator. That’s everything from chip-level architecture and interconnects, through board design and thermal management, to full system integration and bring-up. At Fractile, we know that world-class system architecture is the foundation every other part of the stack is built on.

About the team and role
The System Architecture team at Fractile defines how our hardware comes together — from chip interfaces and interconnects through to board design, thermal management, and system-level integration — working closely with digital design, verification, firmware and software teams to make sure architecture choices translate cleanly into working silicon and reliable hardware platforms.


As an Early Career System Architect, you’ll support senior architects in defining and refining this architecture, and get hands-on exposure to early prototyping, bring-up, and system testing as ideas become real hardware.

About you
We’re looking for someone early in their career with a strong foundation in digital systems and computer architecture, gained through a degree, internships, or personal projects, who is genuinely curious about how complex hardware systems are taken from concept through to production. You’ll be comfortable working across disciplines — hardware, firmware, and software — and keen to learn fast in a fast-moving environment.

Key Requirements

  • A degree (or final-year study) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field

  • Exposure to system-level design concepts — power, thermal, I/O, memory, or interconnect architectures — through academic projects, internships, or personal projects

  • Some familiarity with digital design flows, gained through coursework, internships, or personal projects

  • Comfortable working across disciplines — hardware, firmware, and software

  • Attestation at boot and at runtime, and management-plane protocols (DICE, IETF RATS, SPDM, MCTP, PLDM; confidential-computing directions like TDISP)

  • Hardware building blocks and firmware/Linux hardening (HSM, TPM, secure element, Caliptra, secure debug; open firmware/boot projects, image minimisation)

  • Assurance and resistance (supply-chain security with SBOM and SLSA, fuzzing and testing, standards like NIST 800-series, Common Criteria, OCP incl. S.A.F.E., TCG/DMTF; physical and side-channel awareness)

  • AI/LLM-assisted security tooling, and RISC-V / GPU / ML-accelerator experience

What you’re signing up for:

This is a young company doing hard things, balanced across hardware and software. We’re building the software layer for a whole inference system as it takes shape, so you’ll often be securing systems ahead of the hardware: reasoning about a threat model against a specification first, then a simulator, then early boards. You’ll work with incomplete information and watch it get sharper with every iteration. That takes comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action. If that sounds daunting, this may not be the role. If it sounds like the fun part, we should talk.

Boundaries between areas are soft here. Security touches every layer, so you’ll work across bare metal, RTOS, and Linux, and alongside the architecture and hardware teams as much as the rest of the software team. That breadth is a good part of the job.

You’ll be there for first bring-up, the first secure boot that verifies, the first device that attests itself, the first clean end-to-end run. A piece of what you built will live in silicon and in every rack we ship.

We want a team that reflects the world it’s built for, and we welcome applicants from every background, including those whose path here hasn’t been a straight line. We care that you’re excited by this kind of work, that you bring security rigour, and that you make a team better.

raw.description:
Et si ton expertise comptable devenait un véritable levier pour aider les entrepreneurs et les cabinets à mieux piloter leur activité ?

Chez Pennylane, nous construisons le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PME européennes. Notre plateforme aide les entrepreneurs à gagner du temps sur les tâches comptables et financières, et permet aux cabinets d’expertise-comptable de se concentrer davantage sur le conseil et l’accompagnement de leurs clients.

Aujourd’hui, nous recrutons une personne ayant exercé comme collaborateur ou collaboratrice comptable en cabinet, et souhaitant mettre son expertise métier au service de l’accompagnement de nos utilisateurs. Ta connaissance de la comptabilité et des réalités quotidiennes des cabinets te permettra de comprendre rapidement leurs problématiques, de leur apporter des réponses adaptées et de les aider à tirer pleinement parti de Pennylane.

🌍 Pennylane, c'est quoi ?

Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1 000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs qui recommanderaient Pennylane à leurs proches

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail vraiment flexible

🚀 Déjà plus de 900 000 TPE/PME et plus de 6 000 cabinets d'expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

🎯 Ton rôle

Tu rejoins l’équipe Support applicatif et technique en tant qu’expert métier et plateforme.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié des dirigeants, des comptables internalisés et des cabinets d’expertise-comptable qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur comptabilité et leurs finances.

Au quotidien, tu analyses leurs problématiques, les accompagnes dans la résolution de leurs demandes et les aides à tirer pleinement parti de la plateforme. Tu contribues également à l’amélioration du produit en faisant remonter des retours structurés aux équipes internes.

📋 Tes missions

Support et résolution de problèmes

  • Réceptionner, qualifier et analyser les demandes des utilisateurs

  • Comprendre leur problématique et leur contexte métier

  • Apporter des réponses claires, pédagogiques et adaptées

  • Assurer le suivi des tickets jusqu’à leur résolution complète

  • Escalader les sujets complexes aux équipes techniques ou produit

  • Garantir un haut niveau de qualité de service

Accompagnement des migrations

  • Aider les comptables en entreprise et en cabinet à intégrer leurs données dans Pennylane

  • Comprendre les enjeux liés à la migration depuis un autre logiciel comptable

  • Identifier les éventuelles difficultés et coordonner leur résolution

  • Participer à l’amélioration des processus et de la documentation associés

Amélioration continue et partage d’expertise

  • Créer et mettre à jour les supports d’aide destinés aux utilisateurs

  • Identifier les questions récurrentes et favoriser l’autonomie des clients

  • Partager tes connaissances comptables avec l’équipe

  • Faire remonter les irritants et les besoins aux équipes produit

  • Proposer des améliorations sur les process et les outils internes

🚀 Tes premiers mois chez Pennylane

  • Tu te formes sur le produit et les process de l’équipe

  • Tu découvres l’entreprise, sa vision et ses différents départements

  • Tu apprends à identifier les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement

  • Tu commences à traiter des demandes liées à la comptabilité

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends en charge tes demandes de bout en bout

  • Tu traites des problématiques de plus en plus complexes

  • Tu contribues aux supports d’aide et au partage de connaissances

  • Tu deviens un relais de la voix du client auprès des équipes produit

Et ensuite

Tu deviens progressivement un expert produit et métier, capable d’identifier les axes d’amélioration et de porter des projets. Des évolutions vers des sujets Support plus complexes, la gestion de comptes ou la mise en œuvre de Pennylane sont également possibles.

🙋 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Formation comptable : BTS CGO, DCG, BTS Assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Bachelor Responsable administratif et comptable, Master CCA ou équivalent

  • Au moins 3 ans d’expérience en cabinet d’expertise-comptable

  • Idéalement, au moins trois périodes fiscales réalisées

  • Une expérience en contact direct avec des dirigeants est un plus

  • Solides connaissances des principes comptables et de la réalité des cabinets

  • Appétence pour les outils numériques et les nouvelles technologies

  • Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à résoudre des problèmes

  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et pédagogie

  • Sens du service et aisance dans la relation client

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe et à s’adapter rapidement

  • Envie d’apprendre et de suivre les évolutions du produit

  • Anglais professionnel (compréhension écrite, orale et expression écrite)

  • La connaissance de Pennylane est un plus

⚙️ Le process de recrutement

  1. Un premier échange avec un recruteur, 30 minutes

  2. Un entretien et un cas pratique avec un membre de l'équipe, 1 heure

  3. Un entretien final avec la manager d'équipe, 45 minutes

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t’offrir

  • Une mutuelle Alan Blue et Alan Mind

  • Des tickets restaurant via Swile

  • Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

  • Un budget mensuel pour travailler depuis chez toi ou dans un espace de coworking

  • Des bureaux situés à quelques minutes de Saint-Lazare, à Paris

  • Une enveloppe de BSPCE

  • Un accès à 8 000 salles de sport et plus de 300 activités bien-être via Gymlib

  • Un Mac

  • Un accès à Busuu pour perfectionner ton anglais

  • Des Tech Days tous les 3 mois et un séminaire annuel

  • Des activités sportives et des événements réguliers entre collègues

🌱 Pour t’épanouir chez Pennylane

  • Tu apprécies évoluer dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Tu fais de la collaboration une priorité

  • Tu sais prendre du recul et prioriser les actions à fort impact

  • Tu es à l’aise avec l’idée d’apprendre et d’améliorer continuellement tes pratiques

  • Tu peux travailler en anglais, selon les exigences du poste

Tu ne coches pas toutes les cases ? Postule quand même. Les parcours les plus intéressants ne sont pas toujours linéaires. Ce qui compte, c’est ta trajectoire, ton expertise, ta façon de réfléchir et ton envie de contribuer.

Les candidatures doivent être envoyées uniquement via nos canaux officiels, notamment notre site carrière et les pages officielles de nos partenaires.

Nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles se terminant par ----- ou ----- style="min-height:1.5em">Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement ni d’informations financières dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est adressée, ne répondez pas et signalez-la-nous immédiatement.

Pennylane encourage la diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sous toutes leurs formes. Nous offrons un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux comme à distance.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

raw.description:
Why this role exists

At Pennylane, Growth Operations is crucial in transforming prospect data and marketing processes into an automated, reliable, and scalable growth engine.

 

We are hiring a Growth Ops to join our Growth team and work at the intersection of business, data, automation, and AI. Your mission: enhance how we identify, enrich, and activate prospects while building tools that boost Marketing and Sales efficiency.

 

You will also contribute to AI adoption by identifying use cases, creating agents and workflows, testing new tools, and empowering teams to use them effectively.

 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France's leading fintech unicorns, creating the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we empower business owners to make better decisions and enable accountants to focus on client advisory.

 

A few figures to illustrate our scale and ambition:

 

  • 💻 1.3 million+ SMEs already work with Pennylane.

  • 🤝 7,000+ accounting firms use our platform.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 1,100+ Pennylaners representing over 25 nationalities.

  • 💰 €400 million+ raised since launch.

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture as we expand across Europe.

 

What you’ll do

As part of our Growth team, you'll closely collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Operations, and Product.

 

Build scalable automation workflows

  • Design and maintain complex workflows using n8n

  • Automate prospect scraping, enrichment, scoring, and activation

  • Identify CRM bottlenecks and replace manual processes with scalable solutions

  • Connect our data warehouse with Salesforce to generate opportunities and provide actionable insights to Sales

 

Turn data into growth

  • Improve prospect database quality and usability

  • Build tools to help Marketing and Sales generate and activate qualified leads

  • Support acquisition initiatives: outbound, events, partnerships

  • Monitor project impact on lead generation, conversion, and efficiency

 

Drive AI adoption

  • Identify valuable AI use cases for Growth, Marketing, and Sales

  • Create agents, skills, and reusable workflows

  • Experiment with tools like Dust, Cursor, and Claude Code

  • Support adoption via training, documentation, and pilot programs

 

Connect and optimise our stack

  • Integrate tools such as Salesforce, Modjo, Dust, and Livestorm

  • Translate business needs into technical solutions

  • Own projects from scoping to deployment and iteration

  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, CNIL, security, and data governance

 

What you bring

  • Hands-on experience in Growth Ops, Marketing Ops, Revenue Ops, or automation, ideally in B2B SaaS or a scale-up

  • Strong proficiency with n8n and complex, multi-tool workflows

  • Ability to translate business challenges into tech solutions

  • Familiarity with CRM systems, prospect data, scraping, enrichment, and scoring

  • Proven record of impactful automation projects

  • Practical experience using AI tools and supporting adoption

  • Strong communication and project management skills

  • Autonomy, curiosity, and an ownership mindset

  • Professional working proficiency in English

  • Bonus: Experience with SEO, SEA, or the broader acquisition funnel

 

🛠️ Tools and environment

You’ll use tools like n8n, Salesforce, Modjo, Dust, and Livestorm and experiment with solutions such as Cursor, Claude Code, and MCPs.

 

What you can expect

  • A role combining Growth, automation, data, and AI

  • End-to-end ownership with measurable business impact

  • Opportunity to build systems from scratch

  • Key role in shaping automation and AI practices

  • Close collaboration with cross-functional teams

  • A demanding, supportive, execution- and learning-focused environment

 

📍 Location and working model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis

 

🔎 Our recruitment process

  • Talent Acquisition interview (30 min, remote)

  • Hiring Manager interview (1 hour, remote)

  • Case study & debrief (1 hour, remote)

  • Final interview with a Marketing leader (45 min, remote)

  • Team-fit interview (1 hour, in person)

 

🌈 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Pennylane is committed to an inclusive, supportive work environment with equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic.

 

If this role excites you and you believe you could add value, we encourage you to apply—even if you do not meet every requirement.
