title: Senior Data Engineer
description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The role We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team. Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects. Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology. Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you. What you will do Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack. Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition. Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source. Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone. What you bring Must-haves 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production. Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience) Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries. Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage. Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database. Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files. Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line. You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers. A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away. Nice-to-haves Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines. Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect). Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database. LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration. A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians. What we offer Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research. Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day. Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes. Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission. Interview Process Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.

Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.

Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.

Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.

What you will do

  • Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.

  • Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition.

  • Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source.

  • Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production.

  • Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience)

  • Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries.

  • Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage.

  • Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database.

  • Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files.

  • Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line.

  • You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers.

  • A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away.

Nice-to-haves

  • Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines.

  • Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect).

  • Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database.

  • LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration.

  • A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day.

  • Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

title: AI Benchmark Engineer | Native Language Specialist - French (France) - Remote
description: About The Opportunity We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows. We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches. Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity What You’ll Deliver Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents. Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling. Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary). Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus). Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity. Qualifications Experience: 1+ years of industry experience in software engineering. Background: Proven track record at leading technology companies and/or graduation from top-tier engineering universities. Language: Native or near-native fluency, with a deep understanding of its grammar, register, and phrasing rules. High English proficiency. raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Alan Precision: why this exists

Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.

50% of non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, many cancers) are preventable with lifestyle changes, and we're not capturing them. Western countries have seen healthspan flatline for years, meaning we live longer, but not better. 46% of Europeans report mental health issues. The kind of deep, personalised health reading that could change this has been reserved for the few who could afford a 3,000€ check-up, and built for filing reports rather than changing lives.

We don't accept that.

Alan Precision is our bet on advanced prevention as the new norm of care. We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it.

Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.

⭐ The Founding Growth opportunity

Alan Precision is live, with fast week-over-week growth. Now we need to turn a new category into a habit: hundreds of thousands of customers in the coming years, and a measurable impact on their health. You will be the first growth and go-to-market person on the crew, accountable for two numbers: how many members subscribe to Precision, and how many stay, retest and renew.

The crew was launched by the founding team of ARO, acquired by Alan in 2026, to move fast and apply their learnings from building a preventive health company.

It is a unique playground. You get the means of one of France's biggest scale-ups (1M+ members reachable from day one, an ecosystem of products like Mo, Play and Clinic, and a brand carried by ambassadors like Kylian Mbappé) with the culture and pace of a fast-growing startup: small crew, short loops, everything still to invent.

🔭 Scope: Three go-to-market engines

1. Direct-to-member: turn Alan's 1M+ members into Precision subscribers.

Offering paid services that members subscribe to by themselves inside Alan is a pretty new go-to-market for us, and you invent it.

  • Build the CRM and lifecycle engine: segments, triggers, sequences, in-app moments.

  • Use product data to decide who to push Precision to, when and where: which actions, traits or life moments make it relevant, and which do not.

  • Position Precision inside the surfaces of other product crews (Mo, Play, Clinic, Shop), with their teams and push the right message at the right time.

  • Own recurrence: activation after the first check-up, retests, renewals, reactivation. Acquisition without retention does not count.

2. B2B: get Alan's client companies to offer Precision to their employees.

Almost everything is to define: business model, offer format, pricing logic, sales motion.

  • Work with our B2B Marketing team to understand the constraints of our Sales and Account Management teams, give them the right pitch and materials, and set the right targets with them.

  • Meet HR buyers yourself to learn what makes them pay.

3. Beyond Alan: take Precision to the open market.

Once the internal engine runs:

  • Apply the full B2C health and e-commerce playbook to acquire users that are not insured by Alan

  • Your levers will be numerous, across paid acquisition, influence, partnerships, brand.

Across all three:

  • Create demand in a market that is still being created. Talk to members every week, define the value proposition and the messages that make people want advanced prevention, and push for the product changes that go with them.

  • Build a brand people want, and explain it simply. Make advanced prevention desirable and easy to understand, with our Brand team, without overpromising.

  • Say what can be said. Health communication is regulated: medical biology, health claims, influencer rules, use of health data for targeting. You work with our medical and legal teams and turn these constraints into sharper, more credible messages.

  • Measure and decide. Funnels, cohorts, holdouts, channel performance. Pick the next bet, cut what does not work, share what we learned.

  • Own it end to end. From the idea of a strategy to the campaign live in production: you design it, write it, build it, ship it and iterate on it yourself. Sharp copywriting is a core part of the job.

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • You have grown a B2C product from its early days. Ideally as the first growth or go-to-market person, on a subscription in health, wellbeing or e-commerce. You can tell us which channels you picked, which ones you cut, and why.

  • A creative Swiss army knife who prioritises. You can do a bit of everything and you find channels and angles nobody has thought of yet. You know the job is to pick the right one, execute it, measure it and move to the next.

  • Lifecycle and CRM at scale. Customer.io, Braze or equivalent: segmentation, behavioural triggers, in-app moments.

  • Analytical rigour. You read a funnel, build a cohort, set up a holdout and call a result. You measure success in subscribers, retention and revenue.

  • Hands-on, and a great writer. You love taking an idea all the way to production yourself: the strategy, the copy, the campaign, the dashboard. You write well and fast, and you turn a complex medical topic into a clear, desirable promise.

  • Customer-obsessed. You talk to members every week and you are just as comfortable in front of an HR director.

  • Fluent with AI. You build with AI every day: assets, copy variants, segments, analyses and even building your own tools. You use it to go faster, and you keep your judgment on what ships.

  • Driven by health, and rigorous about it. Health matters to you, and when something blocks, you find a way. You make people want to act with messages that hold up in front of a physician.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with regulated health communication (claims, health data, medical services).

  • B2B2C, employee benefits or HR tech.

  • Paid acquisition and influencer marketing in B2C.

  • Pricing and packaging of subscription offers.

  • You own your own health: Whoop, Oura, blood tests, supplements are no secret for you.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: Paris

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.

Du verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungsprojekten, IT-Architekturen und modernen Entwicklungsprozessen. Du denkst unternehmerisch und verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge von IT-Projekten. Du trittst souverän auf und überzeugst durch Kommunikations- und Moderationsstärke sowie eine hohe Entscheidungssicherheit. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mindestens C1-Niveau. Du verfügst über Zertifizierungen wie IPMA, PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen. Du hast bereits kritische oder eskalierte IT-Projekte erfolgreich stabilisiert. description: Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé. Nous avons l'obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs. Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé. title: Stage Chef.fe de projet migration applicative en santé
description: Dans le cadre de la migration de notre application desktop, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire pour piloter le suivi de l’adoption et accompagner nos clients tout au long de leur transition vers la nouvelle solution. L’objectif sera de permettre au plus grand nombre de clients de migrer dans les meilleures conditions avant le transfert progressif du suivi à notre équipe Support, à l’issue du stage. Ce stage combine gestion de projet, communication client, accompagnement au changement, analyse de données et compréhension des environnements informatiques hospitaliers. Tes missions Piloter la communication autour de la migration Tu construiras et déploieras un plan de communication adapté aux différentes étapes de la migration : Identification des clients à contacter et segmentation des populations ; Préparation des messages de premier contact ; Organisation des relances et suivi des réponses ; Adaptation des communications selon le niveau d’avancement des clients ; Gestion des objections, questions et éventuels points de blocage ; Formalisation des bonnes pratiques et des argumentaires. Prioriser les migrations Tu contribueras à définir une stratégie de priorisation des clients en fonction de différents critères : Taille et typologie des établissements ; Niveau de maturité ou de préparation technique ; Contraintes liées à l’environnement informatique ; Niveau d’engagement et de réponse des interlocuteurs ; Risques identifiés et complexité de l’accompagnement nécessaire. L’objectif sera de concentrer les efforts sur les clients présentant le meilleur potentiel de progression ou nécessitant un accompagnement spécifique. Mettre en place un tableau de suivi et des outils de reporting Tu concevras et maintiendras un tableau de bord permettant de suivre l’avancement global de la migration, notamment : Nombre de clients contactés ; Taux de réponse et de relance ; Clients migrés, en cours de migration ou non encore engagés ; Principales raisons de blocage ; Actions réalisées et prochaines étapes ; Indicateurs d’adoption et d’utilisation. Tu t’appuieras notamment sur Mixpanel et sur les outils internes disponibles afin de fiabiliser le suivi et de produire des reportings réguliers à destination des équipes concernées. Accompagner les clients Selon les besoins identifiés, tu pourras également participer directement à l’accompagnement des clients : Réponse aux questions liées à la migration ; Coordination avec les équipes techniques et Support ; Aide à la préparation des étapes de migration ; Suivi des situations nécessitant un accompagnement personnalisé ; Remontée des irritants et des besoins récurrents ; Contribution à l’amélioration continue du parcours de migration. Préparer le transfert à l’équipe Support Une partie importante du stage consistera à préparer la reprise du suivi par l’équipe Support : Documentation du processus de migration ; Centralisation de l’historique et du statut de chaque client ; Formalisation des procédures et réponses types ; Identification des cas particuliers et des risques résiduels ; Transmission des outils, méthodes et indicateurs de pilotage. Profil recherché Tu es étudiant.e en école d’ingénieur ou en formation supérieure spécialisée en informatique, systèmes et réseaux, gestion de projet ou domaine équivalent. Tu disposes idéalement de connaissances en : Administration système et réseau ; Environnements informatiques d’entreprise ; Analyse et suivi de données ; Gestion de projet ou conduite du changement ; Outils de reporting et d’analyse produit, notamment Mixpanel. Une première compréhension des systèmes d’information hospitaliers serait un véritable plus. Nous recherchons surtout une personne : Structurée et organisée ; À l’aise dans les échanges avec des interlocuteurs variés ; Capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle ; Curieuse et autonome ; Dotée d’un bon esprit d’analyse ; À l’aise pour formaliser, synthétiser et suivre des plans d’action ; Orientée résultats et satisfaction client. Ce que tu apprendras Ce stage te permettra de développer une expérience concrète sur : Le pilotage d’un projet de migration à grande échelle ; La communication et l’accompagnement de clients professionnels ; La conduite du changement dans un environnement exigeant ; L’analyse de données produit et l’utilisation de Mixpanel ; La construction d’indicateurs de suivi ; La coordination entre équipes Produit, Technique, Customer Success et Support ; Les enjeux liés aux systèmes d’information hospitaliers. About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

About the role

You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process.

Responsibilities

  • Administer SSO, the directory and the password manager. Handle onboarding and offboarding, and run regular access reviews.

  • Manage the Mac fleet: setup, MDM policies, OS and app updates, and keeping the endpoint security agent installed and working.

  • Apply the security baselines and access policies the security team defines, and keep our tools configured to match.

  • Administer our SaaS tools: setup, admin access and licences. Handle the IT side of bringing on new vendors.

  • Support the security team during incidents by isolating devices, revoking access and pulling logs.

  • Provide evidence for IT controls during audits.

  • Automate repetitive work such as onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and evidence collection.

  • Write and maintain documentation for IT procedures.

  • Take part in IT on-call.

Definition of success

  • 1 month: handles onboarding, offboarding and day-to-day account and device work without help, and knows how our tools are set up.

  • End of probation: owns our identity, device and SaaS setup, has automated at least one process that used to be manual, and is the person the security team goes to for IT changes and incident support.

  • 12 months: runs corporate IT independently. Onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and audit evidence mostly run on tooling they built.

Experience

  • 5+ years in IT, systems engineering or IT security.

  • Hands-on admin experience with an enterprise identity provider, an MDM and endpoint security tools.

  • Strong macOS management: configuration profiles, privacy preference and system extension policies.

  • Writes Python or Bash to automate work. Infrastructure as code is a plus.

  • Has supported a SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audit.

  • Knows crypto companies are frequent targets of phishing and social engineering, and sets up systems with that in mind. Web3 or fintech experience is a plus.

  • Writes clear documentation.

  • Prefers simple setups people follow over perfect ones they work around.

  • Comfortable being part of an on-call rotation.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year [more than CHF 250 million] in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year [more than CHF 250 million] in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. About AI Engineering at Rivia Given the highly complex nature of clinical trials and how they interface with our technology, the AI Engineering team at Rivia is pivotal in ensuring our clients achieve their desired outcomes and derive maximum value from our platform. The team designs and operates agentic, production-grade AI workflows that power critical monitoring, data quality, and insight-generation capabilities for clinical trial stakeholders.​ By building reliable, auditable, and scalable AI systems, AI Engineering helps transform fragmented clinical data into actionable intelligence and positions Rivia as the AI-first platform for clinical trial intelligence. The Role As a Senior AI Engineer at Rivia, you will architect and ship high-impact AI workflows that materially improve how clinical trial teams monitor studies, assess data quality, and make operational decisions.​ You will work as a key technical contributor embedded in product initiatives, owning AI features end-to-end from design and evaluation through to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.​ The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer who combines deep LLM and agentic systems expertise with strong software engineering skills, a bias to action, and a passion for turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, commercially impactful products in a complex, regulated domain. What excites you Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on the product, the business, and the team. Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials. Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential. Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape. Responsibilities Architect and ship production-grade agentic AI workflows, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, and structured outputs, for clinical trial intelligence use cases. Translate user workflows and product requirements into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production and optimize for user and business value. Design and maintain evaluation pipelines, including gold sets, metrics, and experiments, and use them to drive iteration with rigor. Implement robust LLMOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, cost and latency management, safe deployment, and continuous improvement of AI systems in production. title: Business Development Intern
description: Big changes start with people who want to achieve more. How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice? At Urban Connect , we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom. Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility. To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together. Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen? During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities. Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work. How you will make a difference Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions. Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts. Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected. Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes. Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships. Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions. Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps. Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team. What you bring An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject. Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative. An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply. Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things. Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us. An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team. Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus. Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it. What you can expect High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow. We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving. A view of the whole business. You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value. Direct access and room to take initiative. Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment. The opportunity to build a future with us. If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company. You will also benefit from: Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich. A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars. A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together! Ready to make a difference? Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself? We look forward to meeting you. Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

QuantWare is seeking an Experimental Quantum Engineer to join our growing Operations team. The mission of QuantWare’s Operations team is to consistently deliver high quality quantum hardware and make advanced quantum technologies accessible to customers all over the world.

Together with your colleague Experimental Quantum Engineers, you will be in charge of several state of the art cryogenic setups. You’ll use these setups to perform advanced qubit measurements and guarantee the quality of all devices before they are shipped to customers. Whenever you spot abnormalities, you’ll search for root causes and countermeasures, together with your colleagues from Fabrication or Design. Product volume and complexity of our products increase - so the challenge is to stay one step ahead by continuously improving our measurement setups, software and processes.

What you will be doing

  • Own QuantWare’s cryogenic measurement setups: purchase and build them, and keep them state-of-the-art (maintenance, upgrades).

  • Manage the hands-on physical operation of cryogenic quantum hardware, working directly with the dilution refrigerators.

  • Develop measurement code to implement and refine Python-based routines for device characterization.

  • Characterize quantum chips to evaluate and improve the performance of superconducting qubits and amplifiers - to guarantee QuantWare’s customers receive perfect devices and to support new product development and research.

Your Profile

  • Education: master’s degree in physics or electrical engineering, preferably with a focus on quantum computing.

  • Experience: Hands-on experience with programming, preferably Python.

  • Knowledge: Experience with superconducting circuits and microwave measurement techniques is a plus, but not required.

  • Skills: you are tech-savvy, learn fast and get things done: regardless if that means getting your hands dirty or deep in the python code. You enjoy solving problems and methodically improving our processes.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Product Design stage
description: Werken als Product Design stagiair in een productgedreven bedrijf met een heldere missie? Dat kan bij Crisp! Wij willen beter eten voor meer mensen beschikbaar maken. Als Product Design Stagiair help je, samen met een ijzersterk team, de ervaring van de inmiddels tienduizenden gebruikers van de Crisp-app naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Kom jij ons team versterken vanaf februari 2027? Wat je gaat doen Je geeft mede vorm aan hoe AI en ons Design System elkaar versterken en je bouwt mee aan de toekomstige werkwijze voor Product Design en Frontend Development. Zo draag je direct bij aan elke stap in ons ontwerpproces, van het eerste onderzoek en prototyping tot de uiteindelijke implementatie. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Product Designers en in-house developers. Je krijgt de ruimte om echt impact te maken. We werken op hoog niveau en waarderen een proactieve houding en een gezonde dosis eigen initiatief. Dit ben jij Je volgt een relevante hbo- of wo-opleiding, zoals Computer Science, Communication & Multimedia Design, Interaction Design of Strategic Product Design. Je hebt affiniteit met design, AI en front-end development. Die passie laat je bijvoorbeeld zien door middel van (het begin van) een portfolio of met relevante projecten. Je hebt al wat ervaring met Design Systems in Figma en AI-coding tools (zoals Claude Code, Cursor, Codex of iets anders) en vindt het leuk om daar nog behendiger in te worden. Je hebt bij voorkeur (beginnende) ervaring met React (Native) of vergelijkbare frond-end frameworks. Je bent leergierig, kritisch en durft vragen te stellen. Je onderbouwt je keuzes en staat open voor feedback. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen. Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren. Een kijkje in de keuken van een van de snelst ontwikkelende bedrijven in de Europese markt. Een gratis lunch van Crisp. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Tijd om je collega’s te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. You don’t need to be an After Effects pro, but you get excited about how things move and feel. Bonus points if you have: ✨ Hands-on experience with motion or video tools (like After Effects or Premiere), or with designing for social platforms like Instagram and TikTok. Not a dealbreaker if that’s not your world yet; it’s something we’re happy to grow together. 1st class extras Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet. Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, assessed during the interview process. Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan. We're an Amsterdam-based team of 95+ (and counting) with 20+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 22 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition: Product Design at Polarsteps

We’re a small team, doing big things.

At Polarsteps, everyone, our CEO, support specialists, developers, product managers, and more, cares about design. It’s part of our DNA and embedded in every discussion. This gives you, as a Product Designer, the opportunity to make full use of your skills and craft your designs to perfection.

Our relatively small team consists of like-minded design enthusiasts who can geek out over the nitty-gritty details–corner radius, shadows, colors–for hours. We are big on collaboration, challenge each other, and make meetings as fun as they are productive. We dream big, move fast and welcome ideas, from anyone.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like on a typical day.

Lead the design of our “Digital Relive” team, focused on one of travel’s most meaningful moments: looking back on it all. We’re building new ways for travelers to relive their trips, both on the road and once they’re home, from in-app experiences to shareable formats like Trip Reels and Map Video.

You will:

  • Oversee the full product lifecycle of concepting, prototyping, and iterating based on design reviews, user testing, feedback, and data like share rates.

  • Implement and maintain the existing design & brand guidelines while also creating and adapting guidelines to elevate the overall Polarsteps design, including the look and feel of our shareable formats.

  • Own your product pillar, while maintaining close collaboration with the other pillars. Proactively ask for and share feedback to keep our product smooth, consistent, and awesome.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers to ensure your designs are well-specced and built as intended, down to the last pixel and color.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you.

✅ Being a seasoned professional with 5+ years of experience designing lovable products;
✅ A strong portfolio, with shipped designs, that demonstrates end-to-end (hybrid UX and UI) product design, with a strong visual eye for typography, layout, and storytelling;
✅ Experience designing for native mobile apps;
✅ Hands-on experience with user insights and testing, like A/B tests and usability studies;
✅ A proactive mindset, with a passion for getting involved in the entire product development process, thinking and problem-solving like a product manager;
✅ Fluency in modern design tools such as Figma/Sketch or similar;
✅ Experience in prototyping tools such as Principle/Protopie or similar;
✅ Skills in partnering with engineers to drive QA processes and uphold implementation fidelity;
✅ A genuine interest in motion, video, and visual storytelling, and the curiosity to grow in it. You don’t need to be an After Effects pro, but you get excited about how things move and feel.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Hands-on experience with motion or video tools (like After Effects or Premiere), or with designing for social platforms like Instagram and TikTok. Not a dealbreaker if that’s not your world yet; it’s something we’re happy to grow together.

 

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 75.000 - 90.000 gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, assessed during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny new MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you)

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

title: Account Executive - Belgian French speaking
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses. We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones. But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you! What will you be doing? Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market, mainly focusing on the Belgian market; Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle); Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer; Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs; Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce; Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process; Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features. What we're looking for Native French speaker; Excellent communication and video presentation skills; Experience working with the Benelux or Nordics markets; Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives; Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives; Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle; Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound; Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team; Customer-centric mindset; You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain. What we offer 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays. An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing. A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use. Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office. Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk. Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party. Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones. Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about. Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected. A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk. Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs. Interview Process Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins - Virtual Assessment Interview - 90 mins - Virtual Final Interview - 30 mins - Virtual Values Interview - 30mins IRL AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. You decide where to remove manual work first, so that volume growth does not need proportional growth in manual work, and you work with Product, Engineering and Operational Excellence to deliver it.</li> <li>Act as the senior operations voice to EMEA Operational Excellence, Global Product and Engineering. You help set the direction for EMEA as a whole, not just for your own area.</li> <li>Partner with EMEA commercial leadership (GMs) and global operations leaders in other regions. ideally other European languages</li> <li>Excellent technical skills (e.g. Claude, N8N, Looker, Excel)</li> <li>Owner's mindset and strong discipline across the whole organisation</li> <li>Customer obsession, with high standards as a point of pride</li> <li>An operator at heart who removes waste and redesigns processes for lean, scalable efficiency</li> <li>Dives into metrics to fix root causes while delivering the short-term wins that stabilise operations</li> <li>Builds trust through transparent, concise communication and encourages the team to challenge the status quo</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's in it for you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a&nbsp; thriving multinational environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis&nbsp;</li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover&nbsp; home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam</li> <li>Amazing office in the heart of Amsterdam.&nbsp;</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport.&nbsp;</li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members</li> <li>Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.&nbsp;<br><br> <p>#LI-onsite</p> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">#LI-AS1</span></p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. title: Stage Operations & Events | Amsterdam Light Festival | Amsterdam mbo/hbo/wo
description: Wat ga je doen? Als Operations & Events Stagiair(e) help je mee om onze dagelijkse vaarten soepel te laten verlopen. Je ondersteunt het Operations-team op kantoor en op de kade, met een focus op het Amsterdam Light Festival. Dit is een van de drukste periodes van het jaar. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld bij de planning, coördineert vertrekkende boten en begeleidt gasten bij het instappen. Zo zorg je er samen met je collega's voor dat alles goed verloopt en gasten een fijne ervaring hebben. Je stage is afwisselend, met een combinatie van organiseren en praktisch aanpakken. Wat ga je leren? Helpen bij de voorbereiding en uitvoering van het Amsterdam Light Festival; Ondersteunen bij de planning, roosters en administratie; Gasten ontvangen, instappen begeleiden en wachtrijen op de kade coördineren; Contact onderhouden met planners, duty managers, hosts, schippers en havenpartners; Checklists en registraties bijhouden en operationele gegevens verwerken; Meewerken aan projecten en verbeteringen binnen Operations. Praktisch Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk; Duur: 3 tot 6 maanden; Type stage: meewerkstage; Werktijden: Een combinatie van kantoortijden en operationele diensten. Beschikbaarheid in avonden en weekenden is vereist; Stagevergoeding: € 500 per maand; Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam en de kade. Wat we aanbieden Een afwisselende meewerkstage waarin je zowel organisatorische als praktische ervaring opdoet; De kans om mee te werken aan de vaarten van het Amsterdam Light Festival en een uniek kijkje achter de schermen te krijgen bij een van de grootste rondvaartoperaties van Amsterdam; Een centraal gelegen kantoor op ca. 15 minuten lopen van Amsterdam Centraal; Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten; Een heerlijke verzorgde lunch op kantoor; 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding. Functievereisten Een mbo-, hbo- of wo-opleiding in operations, events, hospitality, toerisme of bedrijfskunde; Een betrouwbare, praktische en gastgerichte instelling; Het vermogen om rustig te blijven bij drukte en flexibel omgaan met wisselende taken; Goede beheersing van het Engels, kennis van het Nederlands is een pre; Beschikbaar tijdens het Amsterdam Light Festival (ALF), ook in de avonden en weekenden; Kennis van Excel is een plus. Over Flagship Amsterdam Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers. Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
